## cent: request and result types

<details>
<summary>114 types</summary>

#### `ApnsPushNotification`

ApnsPushNotification is a notification for APNs. Centrifugo PRO only.

- `headers: dict[str, str] = {}` - headers are the APNs request headers.
- `payload: JSON = None` - payload is the APNs payload as JSON. Required.

#### `BlockUserRequest`

BlockUserRequest blocks a user: the user is disconnected and can not
connect again until unblocked or the block expires. Centrifugo PRO only.

- `expire_at: int = 0` - expire_at is the Unix time in seconds when the block expires. Optional, but a reasonably small value is recommended to keep the set of blocked users small.
- `user: str = ''` - user is the ID of the user to block. Required.

#### `BlockUserResult`

BlockUserResult is the result of a block user call. Empty at the moment.
Centrifugo PRO only.

#### `BroadcastRequest`

BroadcastRequest publishes the same data into many channels.

- `channels: list[str] = []` - channels is the list of channels to publish into. Required.
- `data: JSON = None` - data is the payload to publish into each channel. Required unless b64data is set. In the HTTP API it is any JSON value; over GRPC it may be binary.
- `b64data: str = ''` - b64data is a base64-encoded binary payload, an alternative to `data` to send binary over the HTTP API. Centrifugo decodes it before publishing.
- `skip_history: bool = False` - skip_history skips adding the publications to the channels' history.
- `tags: dict[str, str] = {}` - tags is a map of arbitrary string keys and values attached to each publication and delivered to clients.
- `idempotency_key: str = ''` - idempotency_key drops duplicate publications upon retries. It acts per channel: a broadcast retried with the same key is not published again into the channels which already have it. Results are kept for 5 minutes by default. The memory, Redis and PostgreSQL brokers keep keys; the NATS broker ignores them.
- `delta: bool = False` - delta tells Centrifugo to construct a delta update, if possible, when broadcasting the publications to subscribers.
- `version: int = 0` - version, when > 0, is the version of the document being sent: publications with a version less than or equal to one already seen are ignored. Only works in channels with history enabled.
- `version_epoch: str = ''` - version_epoch is the epoch of version. When it changes, Centrifugo accepts the publication even if its version is lower than before.

#### `CancelPushRequest`

CancelPushRequest cancels a delayed push notification (sent with
send_at). Centrifugo PRO only.

- `uid: str = ''` - uid is the uid of the push notification to cancel. Required.

#### `CancelPushResult`

CancelPushResult is the result of a cancel push call. Empty at the
moment. Centrifugo PRO only.

#### `ChannelContext`

ChannelContext is context of a channel subscription.
Centrifugo PRO only.

- `source: int = 0` - source is the source of the channel subscription (for example, subscription token, subscribe proxy or server API).

#### `ChannelInfo`

ChannelInfo is information about an active channel.

- `num_clients: int = 0` - num_clients is the number of connections subscribed to the channel.

#### `ChannelsRequest`

ChannelsRequest returns active channels (with one or more subscribers).
It can be heavy on large deployments: there is no pagination.

- `pattern: str = ''` - pattern filters channels by name, using gobwas/glob syntax.

#### `ChannelsResult`

ChannelsResult is the result of a channels call.

- `channels: dict[str, ChannelInfo] = {}` - channels maps channel name to information about the channel.

#### `ClientInfo`

ClientInfo describes a client connection.

- `user: str = ''` - user is the user ID.
- `client: str = ''` - client is the client ID.
- `conn_info: JSON = None` - conn_info is optional connection info.
- `chan_info: JSON = None` - chan_info is optional channel info.

#### `ConnectionInfo`

ConnectionInfo is information about a client connection.
Centrifugo PRO only.

- `app_name: str = ''` - app_name is the client application name, if provided by the client.
- `app_version: str = ''` - app_version is the client application version, if provided by the client.
- `transport: str = ''` - transport is the name of the connection transport.
- `protocol: str = ''` - protocol is the connection protocol: json or protobuf.
- `user: str = ''` - user is the user ID of the connection.
- `state: ConnectionState | None = None` - state is the connection state.
- `connected_at_ms: int = 0` - connected_at_ms is the Unix time in milliseconds when the connection was established.
- `ping_pong_latency_ms: int = 0` - ping_pong_latency_ms is the last measured client ping/pong round-trip latency in milliseconds. Can be -1 if not available.
- `labels: dict[str, str] = {}` - labels are the client labels attached to the connection.

#### `ConnectionState`

ConnectionState is the state of a client connection.
Centrifugo PRO only.

- `channels: dict[str, ChannelContext] = {}` - channels maps the channels the client is subscribed to to their context.
- `connection_token: ConnectionTokenInfo | None = None` - connection_token is information about the connection token.
- `subscription_tokens: dict[str, SubscriptionTokenInfo] = {}` - subscription_tokens maps channel to information about the subscription token used to subscribe to it.
- `meta: JSON = None` - meta is the meta information attached to the connection. It is not visible to other clients: Centrifugo never sends it. Meta from a connection token is visible to the user owning the token, though: it must not hold anything that user must not see.

#### `ConnectionTokenInfo`

ConnectionTokenInfo is information about a connection token.
Centrifugo PRO only.

- `uid: str = ''` - uid is the unique token ID (jti claim).
- `issued_at: int = 0` - issued_at is the Unix time in seconds when the token was issued.

#### `ConnectionsRequest`

ConnectionsRequest returns information about active connections, without
the need to enable presence. At least one of user, expression or
label_filter must be set. Centrifugo PRO only.

- `user: str = ''` - user returns only the connections of this user ID.
- `expression: str = ''` - expression is a CEL expression to filter connections.
- `label_filter: FilterNode | None = None` - label_filter restricts the listing to clients whose labels match this filter. Centrifugo PRO only.

#### `ConnectionsResult`

ConnectionsResult is the result of a connections call.
Centrifugo PRO only.

- `connections: dict[str, ConnectionInfo] = {}` - connections maps client ID to information about the connection.

#### `DeleteUserStatusRequest`

DeleteUserStatusRequest deletes the status of users. Centrifugo PRO only.

- `users: list[str] = []` - users is the list of user IDs to delete the status for. Required.

#### `DeleteUserStatusResult`

DeleteUserStatusResult is the result of a delete user status call. Empty
at the moment. Centrifugo PRO only.

#### `Device`

Device is a device registered for push notifications. Centrifugo PRO only.

- `id: str = ''` - id is the device ID.
- `platform: str = ''` - platform is the device platform.
- `provider: str = ''` - provider is the device token provider.
- `token: str = ''` - token is the device token. For webpush, it is the subscription endpoint.
- `user: str = ''` - user is the user associated with the device.
- `created_at: int = 0` - created_at is the Unix time in milliseconds when the device was created.
- `updated_at: int = 0` - updated_at is the Unix time in milliseconds when the device was last updated.
- `meta: dict[str, str] = {}` - meta is the device meta. Only set if include_meta was requested.
- `topics: list[str] = []` - topics are the device topics. Only set if include_topics was requested.
- `timezone: str = ''` - timezone is the device timezone.
- `locale: str = ''` - locale is the device locale.
- `webpush_keys: str = ''` - webpush_keys is the Web Push subscription keys JSON ({p256dh, auth}). Only set if include_webpush_keys was requested.

#### `DeviceFilter`

DeviceFilter selects devices. Centrifugo PRO only.

- `ids: list[str] = []` - ids selects devices by ID.
- `users: list[str] = []` - users selects devices by user.
- `topics: list[str] = []` - topics selects devices by subscribed topic.
- `providers: list[str] = []` - providers selects devices by token provider.
- `platforms: list[str] = []` - platforms selects devices by platform.

#### `DeviceListRequest`

DeviceListRequest returns a paginated list of registered devices.
Centrifugo PRO only.

- `filter: DeviceFilter | None = None` - filter selects the devices to list. Required.
- `include_total_count: bool = False` - include_total_count includes the total count for the filter in the result.
- `include_meta: bool = False` - include_meta includes meta of each device.
- `include_topics: bool = False` - include_topics includes topics of each device.
- `include_webpush_keys: bool = False` - include_webpush_keys includes webpush_keys of each device (webpush only).
- `cursor: str = ''` - cursor is the pagination cursor: next_cursor of the previous page, empty for the first page.
- `limit: int = 0` - limit is the maximum number of devices to return.

#### `DeviceListResult`

DeviceListResult is the result of a device list call.
Centrifugo PRO only.

- `items: list[Device] = []` - items are the devices of this page.
- `next_cursor: str = ''` - next_cursor is the cursor of the next page. Empty if there is no next page.
- `total_count: int = 0` - total_count is the total count for the filter, if include_total_count was set.

#### `DeviceLocaleUpdate`

DeviceLocaleUpdate sets the locale of devices. Centrifugo PRO only.

- `locale: str = ''` - locale is the locale to set. Required.

#### `DeviceMetaUpdate`

DeviceMetaUpdate sets the meta of devices. Centrifugo PRO only.

- `meta: dict[str, str] = {}` - meta is the meta to set. Required.

#### `DeviceRegisterRequest`

DeviceRegisterRequest registers a device for push notifications, or
updates a registered one. Centrifugo PRO only.

- `id: str = ''` - id is the device ID. Omit it on first registration: Centrifugo generates one and returns it. Pass the stored value to update the device.
- `provider: str = ''` - provider is the provider of the device token: fcm, hms, apns or webpush. Required.
- `token: str = ''` - token is the push token of the device. For webpush, it is the browser PushSubscription serialized as a JSON string. Required.
- `platform: str = ''` - platform is the device platform: ios, android or web. Required.
- `user: str = ''` - user is the user associated with the device.
- `meta: dict[str, str] = {}` - meta is additional custom metadata of the device.
- `topics: list[str] = []` - topics is the full list of the device's topic subscriptions, replacing the previous one. The user's topics are attached automatically.
- `timezone: str = ''` - timezone is the IANA time zone of the device user, for example Europe/Nicosia.
- `locale: str = ''` - locale is the locale of the device user as an IETF BCP 47 language tag, for example en-US.

#### `DeviceRegisterResult`

DeviceRegisterResult is the result of a device register call.
Centrifugo PRO only.

- `id: str = ''` - id is the ID of the registered or updated device.

#### `DeviceRemoveRequest`

DeviceRemoveRequest removes devices, selected by ids and/or users.
Centrifugo PRO only.

- `ids: list[str] = []` - ids selects devices to remove by ID.
- `users: list[str] = []` - users selects devices to remove by user.

#### `DeviceRemoveResult`

DeviceRemoveResult is the result of a device remove call. Empty at the
moment. Centrifugo PRO only.

#### `DeviceTimezoneUpdate`

DeviceTimezoneUpdate sets the timezone of devices. Centrifugo PRO only.

- `timezone: str = ''` - timezone is the IANA time zone to set. Required.

#### `DeviceTopic`

DeviceTopic is a topic subscription of a device. Centrifugo PRO only.

- `id: str = ''` - id is the ID of the device topic.
- `topic: str = ''` - topic is the topic.
- `device: Device | None = None` - device is the device. Only set if include_device was requested.

#### `DeviceTopicFilter`

DeviceTopicFilter selects device topic subscriptions. Centrifugo PRO only.

- `device_ids: list[str] = []` - device_ids selects by device ID.
- `device_providers: list[str] = []` - device_providers selects by device token provider.
- `device_platforms: list[str] = []` - device_platforms selects by device platform.
- `device_users: list[str] = []` - device_users selects by device user.
- `topics: list[str] = []` - topics selects by topic.
- `topic_prefix: str = ''` - topic_prefix selects by topic prefix.

#### `DeviceTopicListRequest`

DeviceTopicListRequest returns a paginated list of device topic
subscriptions. Centrifugo PRO only.

- `filter: DeviceTopicFilter | None = None` - filter selects the device topics to list.
- `include_total_count: bool = False` - include_total_count includes the total count for the filter in the result.
- `include_device: bool = False` - include_device includes the Device of each item.
- `cursor: str = ''` - cursor is the pagination cursor: next_cursor of the previous page, empty for the first page.
- `limit: int = 0` - limit is the maximum number of items to return.

#### `DeviceTopicListResult`

DeviceTopicListResult is the result of a device topic list call.
Centrifugo PRO only.

- `items: list[DeviceTopic] = []` - items are the device topics of this page.
- `next_cursor: str = ''` - next_cursor is the cursor of the next page. Empty if there is no next page.
- `total_count: int = 0` - total_count is the total count for the filter, if include_total_count was set.

#### `DeviceTopicUpdateRequest`

DeviceTopicUpdateRequest changes the topics of a device. The device topic
list is what decides who gets a push sent to a topic.
Centrifugo PRO only.

- `device_id: str = ''` - device_id is the ID of the device. Required.
- `op: str = ''` - op is the operation: add, remove or set. Required.
- `topics: list[str] = []` - topics are the topics for the operation.
- `user: str = ''` - user is an optional ownership guard: the update is applied only if the device currently belongs to this user. Otherwise the call fails with a conflict error (or not found if there is no such device).

#### `DeviceTopicUpdateResult`

DeviceTopicUpdateResult is the result of a device topic update call.
Empty at the moment. Centrifugo PRO only.

#### `DeviceTopicsUpdate`

DeviceTopicsUpdate changes the topics of devices. Centrifugo PRO only.

- `op: str = ''` - op is the operation: add, remove or set. Required.
- `topics: list[str] = []` - topics are the topics for the operation.

#### `DeviceUpdateRequest`

DeviceUpdateRequest updates registered devices, selected by ids and/or
users. Centrifugo PRO only.

- `ids: list[str] = []` - ids selects devices by ID.
- `users: list[str] = []` - users selects devices by user.
- `user_update: DeviceUserUpdate | None = None` - user_update changes the user ID of the devices. It does not re-sync user-bound topics; use DeviceRegisterRequest to assign a device to another user.
- `meta_update: DeviceMetaUpdate | None = None` - meta_update updates the device meta.
- `topics_update: DeviceTopicsUpdate | None = None` - topics_update updates the device topics.
- `timezone_update: DeviceTimezoneUpdate | None = None` - timezone_update updates the device timezone.
- `locale_update: DeviceLocaleUpdate | None = None` - locale_update updates the device locale.

#### `DeviceUpdateResult`

DeviceUpdateResult is the result of a device update call. Empty at the
moment. Centrifugo PRO only.

#### `DeviceUserUpdate`

DeviceUserUpdate sets the user of devices. Centrifugo PRO only.

- `user: str = ''` - user is the user ID to set. Required.

#### `Disconnect`

Disconnect describes the code and reason clients are disconnected with.

- `code: int = 0` - code is the disconnect code.
- `reason: str = ''` - reason is the disconnect reason.

#### `DisconnectRequest`

DisconnectRequest disconnects a user's connections.

- `user: str = ''` - user is the ID of the user to disconnect. Required, unless all_users is used in Centrifugo PRO.
- `disconnect: Disconnect | None = None` - disconnect is a custom disconnect code and reason. If not set, clients are disconnected with a force no-reconnect disconnect.
- `client: str = ''` - client limits the call to the connection with this client ID. user is still required.
- `whitelist: list[str] = []` - whitelist is a list of client IDs to keep connected.
- `session: str = ''` - session limits the call to the connection with this session ID. user is still required.
- `label_filter: FilterNode | None = None` - label_filter restricts the call to clients whose labels match this filter. Centrifugo PRO only.
- `all_users: bool = False` - all_users works as SubscribeRequest.all_users. Centrifugo PRO only.

#### `DisconnectResult`

DisconnectResult is the result of a disconnect call. Empty at the moment.

#### `FcmPushNotification`

FcmPushNotification is a notification for FCM. Centrifugo PRO only.

- `message: JSON = None` - message is the FCM Message object as JSON. Required.

#### `FilterNode`

FilterNode is a tree describing a predicate over client labels. Used as
label_filter on Subscribe, Unsubscribe, Disconnect, Refresh and
Connections requests. A node is either a leaf comparison (key, cmp, val or
vals) or a logical operation (op) over child nodes.
Centrifugo PRO only: defined here for protocol-surface consistency,
Centrifugo OSS parses it but ignores it.

- `op: str = ''` - op is the logical operation of a non-leaf node: "and", "or" or "not". Empty for a leaf node.
- `key: str = ''` - key is the label key a leaf node compares.
- `cmp: str = ''` - cmp is the comparison of a leaf node: "eq", "neq", "in", "nin", "ex", "nex", "sw", "ew", "ct", "gt", "gte", "lt" or "lte".
- `val: str = ''` - val is the value to compare with, for single-value comparisons.
- `vals: list[str] = []` - vals are the values to compare with, for "in" and "nin".
- `nodes: list[FilterNode] = []` - nodes are the child nodes of a logical operation.

#### `GetUserStatusRequest`

GetUserStatusRequest returns the status of users. Centrifugo PRO only.

- `users: list[str] = []` - users is the list of user IDs to get the status for. Required.

#### `GetUserStatusResult`

GetUserStatusResult is the result of a get user status call.
Centrifugo PRO only.

- `statuses: list[UserStatus] = []` - statuses are the statuses of the requested users, in the same order.

#### `HistoryRemoveRequest`

HistoryRemoveRequest removes publications from the history of a channel.
The current top stream position is kept, so clients do not get
disconnected because of insufficient state.

- `channel: str = ''` - channel is the name of the channel. Required.

#### `HistoryRemoveResult`

HistoryRemoveResult is the result of a history remove call. Empty at the
moment.

#### `HistoryRequest`

HistoryRequest returns publications from the history of a channel.
History must be enabled for the channel.

- `channel: str = ''` - channel is the name of the channel. Required.
- `limit: int = 0` - limit is the maximum number of publications to return; -1 returns all the channel keeps. If not set, only the current stream position is returned, without publications.
- `since: StreamPosition | None = None` - since returns publications after this stream position.
- `reverse: bool = False` - reverse iterates in reverse order, from latest to earliest.

#### `HistoryResult`

HistoryResult is the result of a history call.

- `publications: list[Publication] = []` - publications is the list of publications.
- `epoch: str = ''` - epoch is the epoch of the current stream.
- `offset: int = 0` - offset is the top offset of the history stream.

#### `HmsPushNotification`

HmsPushNotification is a notification for HMS. Centrifugo PRO only.

- `message: JSON = None` - message is the HMS Message object as JSON. Required.

#### `InfoRequest`

InfoRequest returns information about the running Centrifugo nodes.

#### `InfoResult`

InfoResult is the result of an info call.

- `nodes: list[NodeResult] = []` - nodes is information about all nodes of the cluster.

#### `InvalidateUserTokensRequest`

InvalidateUserTokensRequest revokes all tokens of a user issued before a
certain time (based on the iat claim of a JWT). Centrifugo PRO only.

- `expire_at: int = 0` - expire_at is the Unix time in seconds when the invalidation expires. Optional, but a value matching the token expiration is recommended.
- `user: str = ''` - user is the ID of the user whose tokens to invalidate. Required.
- `issued_before: int = 0` - issued_before is the Unix time in seconds: tokens issued before it are considered revoked. If not set, the current time is used.
- `channel: str = ''` - channel limits the invalidation to subscription tokens for this channel.

#### `InvalidateUserTokensResult`

InvalidateUserTokensResult is the result of an invalidate user tokens
call. Empty at the moment. Centrifugo PRO only.

#### `MapClearRequest`

MapClearRequest removes all state and stream data of a map channel.

- `channel: str = ''` - channel is the name of the map channel. Required.

#### `MapClearResult`

MapClearResult is the result of a map clear call. Empty at the moment.

#### `MapEntry`

MapEntry is an entry of a map channel state or stream.

- `key: str = ''` - key is the entry key.
- `data: JSON = None` - data is the entry data.
- `tags: dict[str, str] = {}` - tags are the entry tags.
- `offset: int = 0` - offset is the offset of the entry in the channel stream.
- `score: int = 0` - score is the sort value of the entry in ordered map channels.
- `removed: bool = False` - removed is true for a removal event.
- `time: int = 0` - time is the time of the publication as Unix milliseconds, if known.

#### `MapPublishRequest`

MapPublishRequest publishes or updates a key in a map channel.

- `channel: str = ''` - channel is the name of the map channel. Required.
- `key: str = ''` - key is the entry key. Required.
- `data: JSON = None` - data is the entry data. In the HTTP API it is any JSON value; over GRPC it may be binary.
- `b64data: str = ''` - b64data is data as base64, for binary over the HTTP API. Centrifugo decodes it.
- `stream_data: JSON = None` - stream_data is currently not used by the server API.
- `b64stream_data: str = ''` - b64stream_data is currently not used by the server API.
- `tags: dict[str, str] = {}` - tags are key-value metadata attached to the publication.
- `idempotency_key: str = ''` - idempotency_key drops duplicate publications upon retries: a publication with a key already used in the channel is not applied again, and its result has the first one's position, with suppressed set and suppress_reason "idempotency". It acts per channel; keys are kept for 5 minutes by default. Every map broker - memory, Redis and PostgreSQL - keeps keys.
- `delta: bool = False` - delta enables delta compression for this publication.
- `version: int = 0` - version is a per-key version: publications with a version not higher than the key's current one are suppressed.
- `version_epoch: str = ''` - version_epoch scopes version. A different epoch resets version comparison.
- `score: int = 0` - score is currently not used by the server API.
- `key_mode: str = ''` - key_mode makes the publish conditional: "if_new" writes only if the key does not exist, "if_exists" only if it exists. Empty always writes.

#### `MapPublishResult`

MapPublishResult is the result of a map publish call.

- `offset: int = 0` - offset is the offset in the channel stream.
- `epoch: str = ''` - epoch is the epoch of the channel stream.
- `suppressed: bool = False` - suppressed is true if the publish was not applied, see suppress_reason.
- `suppress_reason: str = ''` - suppress_reason explains why the publish was suppressed, for example "idempotency", "version", "key_exists" or "key_not_found".

#### `MapReadStateRequest`

MapReadStateRequest reads the current state of a map channel, with
optional pagination.

- `channel: str = ''` - channel is the name of the map channel. Required.
- `cursor: str = ''` - cursor is the pagination cursor from the previous page. Empty starts from the beginning.
- `limit: int = 0` - limit is the maximum number of entries per page: -1 means no limit, 0 returns only the stream position. Page sizes may exceed it with the Redis map broker.
- `key: str = ''` - key reads a single entry by exact key. cursor and limit are ignored when it is set.
- `asc: bool = False` - asc sorts ordered state by score ascending instead of descending. Ignored for unordered channels.
- `revision_offset: int = 0` - revision_offset is the offset of the position from a previous state read, used with revision_epoch.
- `revision_epoch: str = ''` - revision_epoch is the epoch of the position from a previous state read. If the epoch changed, the call fails with an unrecoverable position error.

#### `MapReadStateResult`

MapReadStateResult is the result of a map read state call.

- `entries: list[MapEntry] = []` - entries are the state entries of this page.
- `offset: int = 0` - offset is the offset of the channel stream position.
- `epoch: str = ''` - epoch is the epoch of the channel stream position.
- `cursor: str = ''` - cursor is the cursor of the next page. Empty if there are no more entries.

#### `MapReadStreamRequest`

MapReadStreamRequest reads the change stream of a map channel.

- `channel: str = ''` - channel is the name of the map channel. Required.
- `since_offset: int = 0` - since_offset returns entries after this offset, used with since_epoch.
- `since_epoch: str = ''` - since_epoch is the epoch of the since position. It must match the current stream epoch.
- `limit: int = 0` - limit is the maximum number of entries: -1 means no limit, 0 returns only the stream position.
- `reverse: bool = False` - reverse returns entries newest first.

#### `MapReadStreamResult`

MapReadStreamResult is the result of a map read stream call.

- `entries: list[MapEntry] = []` - entries are the stream entries.
- `offset: int = 0` - offset is the top offset of the channel stream.
- `epoch: str = ''` - epoch is the epoch of the channel stream.

#### `MapRemoveRequest`

MapRemoveRequest removes a key from a map channel.

- `channel: str = ''` - channel is the name of the map channel. Required.
- `key: str = ''` - key is the key to remove. Required.
- `idempotency_key: str = ''` - idempotency_key drops duplicate removals upon retries, as it does for MapPublishRequest: a removal with a key already used in the channel is not applied again, and its result is suppressed with suppress_reason "idempotency". Keys are kept for 5 minutes by default.

#### `MapRemoveResult`

MapRemoveResult is the result of a map remove call.

- `offset: int = 0` - offset is the offset in the channel stream.
- `epoch: str = ''` - epoch is the epoch of the channel stream.
- `suppressed: bool = False` - suppressed is true if the removal was not applied, see suppress_reason.
- `suppress_reason: str = ''` - suppress_reason explains why the removal was suppressed, for example "idempotency" or "key_not_found".

#### `MapStatsRequest`

MapStatsRequest returns statistics about a map channel.

- `channel: str = ''` - channel is the name of the map channel. Required.

#### `MapStatsResult`

MapStatsResult is the result of a map stats call.

- `num_keys: int = 0` - num_keys is the number of entries in the channel state.

#### `Metrics`

Metrics are aggregated metrics of a node.

- `interval: float = 0.0` - interval is the metrics aggregation interval in seconds.
- `items: dict[str, float] = {}` - items maps metric name to value.

#### `NodeResult`

NodeResult is information about a Centrifugo node.

- `uid: str = ''` - uid is the unique ID of the node.
- `name: str = ''` - name is the node name.
- `version: str = ''` - version is the Centrifugo version of the node.
- `num_clients: int = 0` - num_clients is the number of clients connected to the node.
- `num_users: int = 0` - num_users is the number of unique users connected to the node.
- `num_channels: int = 0` - num_channels is the number of active channels on the node.
- `uptime: int = 0` - uptime is the node uptime in seconds.
- `metrics: Metrics | None = None` - metrics are aggregated node metrics, if available.
- `process: Process | None = None` - process is CPU and memory usage of the node process. Centrifugo PRO only.
- `num_subs: int = 0` - num_subs is the number of subscriptions on the node.

#### `PresenceRequest`

PresenceRequest returns the online presence of a channel: all clients
currently subscribed to it. Presence must be enabled for the channel.

- `channel: str = ''` - channel is the name of the channel. Required.

#### `PresenceResult`

PresenceResult is the result of a presence call.

- `presence: dict[str, ClientInfo] = {}` - presence maps client ID to information about the client.

#### `PresenceStatsRequest`

PresenceStatsRequest returns short presence information of a channel: the
number of clients and of unique users. Presence must be enabled for the
channel.

- `channel: str = ''` - channel is the name of the channel. Required.

#### `PresenceStatsResult`

PresenceStatsResult is the result of a presence stats call.

- `num_clients: int = 0` - num_clients is the total number of clients in the channel.
- `num_users: int = 0` - num_users is the number of unique users in the channel.

#### `Process`

Process is resource usage of a node process. Centrifugo PRO only.

- `cpu: float = 0.0` - cpu is the CPU usage of the process in percent.
- `rss: int = 0` - rss is the resident set size of the process in bytes.

#### `Publication`

Publication is a publication in a channel history.

- `data: JSON = None` - data is the publication payload.
- `info: ClientInfo | None = None` - info is information about the client that published, if any.
- `offset: int = 0` - offset is the offset of the publication in the history stream.
- `tags: dict[str, str] = {}` - tags are the publication tags.

#### `PublishRequest`

PublishRequest publishes data into a channel.

- `channel: str = ''` - channel is the name of the channel to publish into. Required.
- `data: JSON = None` - data is the payload to publish. Required unless b64data is set. In the HTTP API it is any JSON value; over GRPC it may be binary.
- `b64data: str = ''` - b64data is a base64-encoded binary payload, an alternative to `data` to send binary over the HTTP API. Centrifugo decodes it before publishing.
- `skip_history: bool = False` - skip_history skips adding this publication to the channel history.
- `tags: dict[str, str] = {}` - tags is a map of arbitrary string keys and values attached to the publication and delivered to clients.
- `idempotency_key: str = ''` - idempotency_key drops duplicate publications upon retries: a publication with a key already used in the channel is not published again, and the first one's result is returned. It acts per channel; results are kept for 5 minutes by default. The memory, Redis and PostgreSQL brokers keep keys; the NATS broker ignores them.
- `delta: bool = False` - delta tells Centrifugo to construct a delta update, if possible, when broadcasting the publication to subscribers.
- `version: int = 0` - version, when > 0, is the version of the document being sent: publications with a version less than or equal to one already seen are ignored. Only works in channels with history enabled.
- `version_epoch: str = ''` - version_epoch is the epoch of version. When it changes, Centrifugo accepts the publication even if its version is lower than before.

#### `PublishResult`

PublishResult is the result of a successful publish.

- `offset: int = 0` - offset is the offset of the publication in the channel history stream.
- `epoch: str = ''` - epoch is the epoch of the channel history stream.

#### `PushLimitStrategy`

PushLimitStrategy limits when and how often pushes are sent.
Centrifugo PRO only.

- `rate_limit: PushRateLimitStrategy | None = None` - rate_limit sets rate limit policies.
- `time_limit: PushTimeLimitStrategy | None = None` - time_limit sets a time limit policy based on the device timezone.

#### `PushLocalization`

PushLocalization holds translations for one language/locale.
Centrifugo PRO only.

- `translations: dict[str, str] = {}` - translations maps variable name to value for the language/locale.

#### `PushNotification`

PushNotification is a push notification in the format of each provider.
Centrifugo PRO only.

- `fcm: FcmPushNotification | None = None` - fcm is the notification for FCM.
- `hms: HmsPushNotification | None = None` - hms is the notification for HMS.
- `apns: ApnsPushNotification | None = None` - apns is the notification for APNs.
- `webpush: WebPushPushNotification | None = None` - webpush is the notification for Web Push.
- `expire_at: int = 0` - expire_at is the Unix time in seconds when Centrifugo stops trying to send the notification. Not related to the providers' TTL fields.

#### `PushRateLimitStrategy`

PushRateLimitStrategy rate limits pushes per device. Centrifugo PRO only.

- `key: str = ''` - key is an optional key for the rate limit policy. Supports variables (device.id and device.user).
- `policies: list[RateLimitPolicy] = []` - policies are the rate limit policies to apply.
- `drop_if_rate_limited: bool = False` - drop_if_rate_limited drops a rate limited push instead of queuing it for later.

#### `PushRecipient`

PushRecipient describes who receives a push notification. Set only one
of its fields. Centrifugo PRO only.

- `filter: DeviceFilter | None = None` - filter sends to devices from Centrifugo device storage that match the filter.
- `fcm_tokens: list[str] = []` - fcm_tokens sends to a list of FCM native tokens.
- `fcm_topic: str = ''` - fcm_topic sends to an FCM native topic.
- `fcm_condition: str = ''` - fcm_condition sends to an FCM native condition.
- `hms_tokens: list[str] = []` - hms_tokens sends to a list of HMS native tokens.
- `hms_topic: str = ''` - hms_topic sends to an HMS native topic.
- `hms_condition: str = ''` - hms_condition sends to an HMS native condition.
- `apns_tokens: list[str] = []` - apns_tokens sends to a list of APNs native tokens.
- `webpush_tokens: list[str] = []` - webpush_tokens sends to a list of raw Web Push subscriptions, each a PushSubscription JSON string.

#### `PushTimeLimitStrategy`

PushTimeLimitStrategy sends pushes within a window of the device local
time. Centrifugo PRO only.

- `send_after_time: str = ''` - send_after_time is the local time, as HH:MM:SS, after which the push may be sent. Required.
- `send_before_time: str = ''` - send_before_time is the local time, as HH:MM:SS, before which the push must be sent. Required.
- `no_tz_send_now: bool = False` - no_tz_send_now sends the push immediately if the device timezone is not set. By default such pushes are dropped.

#### `RateLimitPolicy`

RateLimitPolicy allows rate pushes per interval_ms. Centrifugo PRO only.

- `rate: int = 0` - rate is the allowed number of pushes per interval. Required.
- `interval_ms: int = 0` - interval_ms is the interval in milliseconds. Required.

#### `RefreshRequest`

RefreshRequest refreshes a user's connections, mostly useful with
unidirectional transports. Without expire_at the connections become
non-expiring.

- `user: str = ''` - user is the ID of the user to refresh. Required, unless all_users is used in Centrifugo PRO.
- `client: str = ''` - client limits the call to the connection with this client ID. user is still required.
- `expired: bool = False` - expired marks the connections as expired and closes them with an expired disconnect reason.
- `expire_at: int = 0` - expire_at is the Unix time in seconds when the connections expire.
- `info: JSON = None` - info attaches or replaces the connection info.
- `session: str = ''` - session limits the call to the connection with this session ID. user is still required.
- `label_filter: FilterNode | None = None` - label_filter restricts the call to clients whose labels match this filter. Centrifugo PRO only.
- `all_users: bool = False` - all_users works as SubscribeRequest.all_users. Centrifugo PRO only.

#### `RefreshResult`

RefreshResult is the result of a refresh call. Empty at the moment.

#### `RevokeTokenRequest`

RevokeTokenRequest revokes a token by its unique ID (jti claim of a JWT).
Clients using the token are disconnected shortly, and can not connect
with it again. Centrifugo PRO only.

- `expire_at: int = 0` - expire_at is the Unix time in seconds when the revocation expires. Optional, but a value matching the token expiration is recommended.
- `uid: str = ''` - uid is the unique ID of the token to revoke (jti claim). Required.

#### `RevokeTokenResult`

RevokeTokenResult is the result of a revoke token call. Empty at the
moment. Centrifugo PRO only.

#### `SendPushNotificationRequest`

SendPushNotificationRequest sends a push notification. The request is
queued and sent to the provider by Centrifugo workers.
Centrifugo PRO only.

- `recipient: PushRecipient | None = None` - recipient is who receives the notification. Required.
- `notification: PushNotification | None = None` - notification is the notification to send. Required.
- `uid: str = ''` - uid is a unique identifier of the request, can be used to cancel the push. UUID v4 is recommended; different requests must use different uids.
- `send_at: int = 0` - send_at is the Unix time in seconds when to send the notification. If not set, the notification is sent immediately.
- `optimize_for_reliability: bool = False` - optimize_for_reliability makes processing heavier, but tolerates edge cases, like not losing inflight pushes when the queue is briefly unavailable.
- `limit_strategy: PushLimitStrategy | None = None` - limit_strategy sets time constraints and rate limits. Only applies with a filter recipient; devices are then processed one by one instead of in batches.
- `analytics_uid: str = ''` - analytics_uid is the identifier for push notification analytics. If not set, uid is used.
- `localizations: dict[str, PushLocalization] = {}` - localizations are optional per language/locale localizations. Setting them enables templating.
- `use_templating: bool = False` - use_templating enables templating of the notification. Only works with a filter recipient.
- `use_meta: bool = False` - use_meta additionally loads device meta while sending, making it available in templating.

#### `SendPushNotificationResult`

SendPushNotificationResult is the result of a send push notification
call. Centrifugo PRO only.

- `uid: str = ''` - uid is the unique identifier of the send request (not a provider message ID). Matches the request uid if it was set.

#### `SharedPollPublishRequest`

SharedPollPublishRequest pushes data for a key directly to clients of a
shared poll channel, without waiting for the next poll cycle. Requires
versioned mode and publish_enabled on the namespace.

- `channel: str = ''` - channel is the name of the shared poll channel. Required.
- `key: str = ''` - key is the item key. Required.
- `data: JSON = None` - data is the item data, delivered to clients as is.
- `b64data: str = ''` - b64data is data as base64, for binary payloads. Centrifugo decodes it.
- `version: int = 0` - version is the item version, must be >= 1. Required. A version not higher than the current one within the same epoch is silently dropped.
- `epoch: str = ''` - epoch is the channel-level publisher epoch. A change resets per-key versions and unsubscribes current subscribers with insufficient state.

#### `SharedPollPublishResult`

SharedPollPublishResult is the result of a shared poll publish call.
Empty at the moment.

#### `StreamPosition`

StreamPosition is a position in a channel stream.

- `offset: int = 0` - offset is the offset in the stream.
- `epoch: str = ''` - epoch is the stream epoch.

#### `SubscribeOptionOverride`

SubscribeOptionOverride overrides channel options for a server-side
subscription. Unset fields keep the value from the channel configuration.

- `presence: bool | None = None` - presence overrides the presence channel option.
- `join_leave: bool | None = None` - join_leave overrides the join_leave channel option.
- `force_recovery: bool | None = None` - force_recovery overrides the force_recovery channel option.
- `force_positioning: bool | None = None` - force_positioning overrides the force_positioning channel option.
- `force_push_join_leave: bool | None = None` - force_push_join_leave overrides the force_push_join_leave channel option.

#### `SubscribeRequest`

SubscribeRequest subscribes active sessions of a user to a channel
(server-side subscription). It does not create a streaming subscription
for the caller.

- `channel: str = ''` - channel is the name of the channel to subscribe to. Required.
- `user: str = ''` - user is the ID of the user to subscribe. Required, unless all_users is used in Centrifugo PRO.
- `expire_at: int = 0` - expire_at is the Unix time in seconds when the subscription expires.
- `info: JSON = None` - info is custom channel info attached to the subscription, used in presence and join/leave messages.
- `b64info: str = ''` - b64info is info as base64, for binary. Centrifugo decodes it.
- `client: str = ''` - client limits the call to the connection with this client ID. user is still required.
- `data: JSON = None` - data is custom subscription data sent to the client in the Subscribe push.
- `b64data: str = ''` - b64data is data as base64, for binary. Centrifugo decodes it.
- `recover_since: StreamPosition | None = None` - recover_since is the stream position to recover publications from.
- `override: SubscribeOptionOverride | None = None` - override dynamically overrides some channel options set in the Centrifugo configuration.
- `session: str = ''` - session limits the call to the connection with this session ID. user is still required.
- `label_filter: FilterNode | None = None` - label_filter restricts the call to clients whose labels match this filter. Centrifugo PRO only.
- `all_users: bool = False` - all_users, when user is empty, targets every connection on every node instead of the anonymous-only bucket. No effect when user is non-empty. Without label_filter it acts on every connection. Centrifugo PRO only.

#### `SubscribeResult`

SubscribeResult is the result of a subscribe call. Empty at the moment.

#### `SubscriptionTokenInfo`

SubscriptionTokenInfo is information about a subscription token.
Centrifugo PRO only.

- `uid: str = ''` - uid is the unique token ID (jti claim).
- `issued_at: int = 0` - issued_at is the Unix time in seconds when the token was issued.

#### `UnblockUserRequest`

UnblockUserRequest unblocks a user. Centrifugo PRO only.

- `user: str = ''` - user is the ID of the user to unblock. Required.

#### `UnblockUserResult`

UnblockUserResult is the result of an unblock user call. Empty at the
moment. Centrifugo PRO only.

#### `UnsubscribeRequest`

UnsubscribeRequest unsubscribes a user from a channel.

- `channel: str = ''` - channel is the name of the channel to unsubscribe from. Required.
- `user: str = ''` - user is the ID of the user to unsubscribe. Required, unless all_users is used in Centrifugo PRO.
- `client: str = ''` - client limits the call to the connection with this client ID. user is still required.
- `session: str = ''` - session limits the call to the connection with this session ID. user is still required.
- `label_filter: FilterNode | None = None` - label_filter restricts the call to clients whose labels match this filter. Centrifugo PRO only.
- `all_users: bool = False` - all_users works as SubscribeRequest.all_users. Centrifugo PRO only.

#### `UnsubscribeResult`

UnsubscribeResult is the result of an unsubscribe call. Empty at the
moment.

#### `UpdatePushStatusRequest`

UpdatePushStatusRequest saves the delivery or interaction status of a
push notification to analytics. Experimental. Centrifugo PRO only.

- `analytics_uid: str = ''` - analytics_uid is the analytics_uid of the push notification (as in SendPushNotificationRequest). Required.
- `status: str = ''` - status is the status of the push notification: delivered or interacted. Required.
- `device_id: str = ''` - device_id is the Centrifugo device ID. Required.
- `msg_id: str = ''` - msg_id is the message ID issued by the provider.

#### `UpdatePushStatusResult`

UpdatePushStatusResult is the result of an update push status call.
Empty at the moment. Centrifugo PRO only.

#### `UpdateUserStatusRequest`

UpdateUserStatusRequest marks users as active and online now, and sets
their state when one is given. Centrifugo PRO only.

- `users: list[str] = []` - users is the list of user IDs to update the status for. Required.
- `state: str = ''` - state is an optional custom state to store in the user status. It can be restricted by the user_status.state_regex option.

#### `UpdateUserStatusResult`

UpdateUserStatusResult is the result of an update user status call. Empty
at the moment. Centrifugo PRO only.

#### `UserStatus`

UserStatus is the status of a user. Centrifugo PRO only.

- `user: str = ''` - user is the user ID.
- `active: int = 0` - active is the last active time as Unix seconds. Not set if unknown.
- `online: int = 0` - online is the last online time as Unix seconds, updated by Centrifugo while the user is connected. Not set if unknown.
- `state: str = ''` - state is the custom state set with UpdateUserStatusRequest.state, if any.

#### `UserTopic`

UserTopic is a topic subscription of a user. Centrifugo PRO only.

- `id: str = ''` - id is the ID of the user topic.
- `user: str = ''` - user is the user ID.
- `topic: str = ''` - topic is the topic.

#### `UserTopicFilter`

UserTopicFilter selects user topic subscriptions. Centrifugo PRO only.

- `users: list[str] = []` - users selects by user.
- `topics: list[str] = []` - topics selects by topic.
- `topic_prefix: str = ''` - topic_prefix selects by topic prefix.

#### `UserTopicListRequest`

UserTopicListRequest returns a paginated list of user topic
subscriptions. Centrifugo PRO only.

- `filter: UserTopicFilter | None = None` - filter selects the user topics to list.
- `include_total_count: bool = False` - include_total_count includes the total count for the filter in the result.
- `cursor: str = ''` - cursor is the pagination cursor: next_cursor of the previous page, empty for the first page.
- `limit: int = 0` - limit is the maximum number of items to return.

#### `UserTopicListResult`

UserTopicListResult is the result of a user topic list call.
Centrifugo PRO only.

- `items: list[UserTopic] = []` - items are the user topics of this page.
- `next_cursor: str = ''` - next_cursor is the cursor of the next page. Empty if there is no next page.
- `total_count: int = 0` - total_count is the total count for the filter, if include_total_count was set.

#### `UserTopicUpdateRequest`

UserTopicUpdateRequest changes the topics of a user. The change is also
applied to the user's registered devices. Centrifugo PRO only.

- `user: str = ''` - user is the user ID. Required.
- `op: str = ''` - op is the operation: add, remove or set. Required.
- `topics: list[str] = []` - topics are the topics for the operation.

#### `UserTopicUpdateResult`

UserTopicUpdateResult is the result of a user topic update call. Empty at
the moment. Centrifugo PRO only.

#### `WebPushPushNotification`

WebPushPushNotification is a notification for Web Push.
Centrifugo PRO only.

- `headers: dict[str, str] = {}` - headers are Web Push HTTP headers. Recognized keys: TTL (seconds, default 4 weeks), Urgency (very-low, low, normal, high) and Topic.
- `payload: JSON = None` - payload is the JSON payload delivered to the browser service worker. Required.

</details>

## cent.proxy: request and result types

<details>
<summary>29 types</summary>

#### `ChannelEvent`

ChannelEvent is a change of a channel's state.

- `time_ms: int = 0` - time_ms is when it happened, in Unix milliseconds.
- `channel: str = ''` - channel is the channel it happened in.
- `type: str = ''` - type is "occupied" when the channel got its first subscriber, "vacated" when it lost its last one. More types may come; the field is a string, not an enum, for JSON interoperability.

#### `ChannelsCapability`

ChannelsCapability grants operations in channels. A connection may do an
operation in a channel when any of its capabilities both allows the
operation and matches the channel. Centrifugo PRO only.

- `channels: list[str] = []` - channels are the channels, or channel patterns, it applies to.
- `allow: list[str] = []` - allow are the operations it grants: "sub" (subscribe), "pub" (publish), "hst" (history) and "prs" (presence).
- `match: str = ''` - match is how channels are matched: empty for exact names, "wildcard" or "regex".

#### `ConnectRequest`

ConnectRequest is sent when a client connects.

- `client: str = ''` - client is the unique ID Centrifugo gave the connection.
- `transport: str = ''` - transport is the connection's transport: "websocket", "sse", "uni_sse" and the like.
- `protocol: str = ''` - protocol is the client protocol: "json" or "protobuf".
- `encoding: str = ''` - encoding is "binary" when the proxy has binary_encoding enabled, so that payloads come in the b64 fields, and "json" otherwise.
- `data: JSON = None` - data is the custom data the client sent with its connect command, if any.
- `b64data: str = ''` - b64data is data in base64, sent instead of data in binary encoding mode.
- `name: str = ''` - name is the client's name, if it sent one.
- `version: str = ''` - version is the client's version, if it sent one.
- `channels: list[str] = []` - channels are the server-side channels the client asks to be subscribed to. The backend checks its permissions and returns the allowed ones in ConnectResult.channels or ConnectResult.subs.

#### `ConnectResult`

ConnectResult accepts the connection.

- `user: str = ''` - user is the ID of the user the connection belongs to. Empty accepts an anonymous connection.
- `expire_at: int = 0` - expire_at is when the connection expires, in Unix seconds, unless refreshed - by the refresh proxy, when one is configured. Zero means it does not expire.
- `info: JSON = None` - info is information about the connection, as JSON: it is part of presence data, join and leave events and the client's publications.
- `b64info: str = ''` - b64info is info in base64, for binary info.
- `data: JSON = None` - data is custom data sent to the client in the connect reply.
- `b64data: str = ''` - b64data is data in base64, for binary data.
- `channels: list[str] = []` - channels are server-side channels to subscribe the connection to.
- `subs: dict[str, SubscribeOptions] = {}` - subs are server-side channels to subscribe the connection to, each with its options.
- `meta: JSON = None` - meta is custom data attached to the connection, as JSON. It is never sent to the client; proxies with include_connection_meta receive it.
- `caps: list[ChannelsCapability] = []` - caps are capabilities granting the connection operations in channels. Centrifugo PRO only.
- `labels: dict[str, str] = {}` - PRO only — client labels attached to the centrifuge.Client by Centrifugo PRO. Parsed by OSS but not used (OSS does not populate centrifuge.ConnectReply.Labels).

#### `FilterNode`

FilterNode is a node of a publication tags filter expression. A leaf node
compares one tag: it sets key, cmp and val or vals, and leaves op empty. A
logical node combines its nodes: it sets op and nodes only.

- `op: str = ''` - op is the logical operation: "and", "or" or "not". Empty for a leaf node.
- `key: str = ''` - key is the tag a leaf node compares.
- `cmp: str = ''` - cmp is the comparison of a leaf node: "eq", "neq", "in", "nin", "ex" (exists), "nex" (does not exist), "sw" (starts with), "ew" (ends with), "ct" (contains), "gt", "gte", "lt" or "lte".
- `val: str = ''` - val is the value most comparisons compare the tag with.
- `vals: list[str] = []` - vals are the values "in" and "nin" compare the tag with.
- `nodes: list[FilterNode] = []` - nodes are the operands of a logical node.

#### `MapPublishRequest`

MapPublishRequest is sent when a client publishes a key into a map channel.

- `client: str = ''` - client is the unique ID Centrifugo gave the connection.
- `transport: str = ''` - transport is the connection's transport.
- `protocol: str = ''` - protocol is the client protocol: "json" or "protobuf".
- `encoding: str = ''` - encoding is "binary" when the proxy has binary_encoding enabled, so that payloads come in the b64 fields, and "json" otherwise.
- `user: str = ''` - user is the connection's user ID.
- `channel: str = ''` - channel is the map channel the client publishes into.
- `key: str = ''` - key is the key the client publishes, empty if it sent none.
- `data: JSON = None` - data is the data the client publishes.
- `b64data: str = ''` - b64data is data in base64, sent instead of data in binary encoding mode.
- `meta: JSON = None` - meta is the connection's meta, when the proxy has include_connection_meta.
- `labels: dict[str, str] = {}` - PRO only — connection labels attached to the originating centrifuge.Client. Centrifugo PRO always populates this from Client.Labels() (no opt-in toggle).

#### `MapPublishResult`

MapPublishResult accepts the publication, even when empty. Fields left
unset keep what the client sent, or the defaults.

- `key: str = ''` - key replaces the key the client sent: to force a key the server derives, such as the user ID.
- `data: JSON = None` - data replaces the data the client sent.
- `b64data: str = ''` - b64data is data in base64, for binary data.
- `tags: dict[str, str] = {}` - tags are attached to the publication: clients cannot send tags, so this is where server-side tag filters get their tags from.
- `score: int = 0` - score is not used by Centrifugo yet.
- `key_mode: str = ''` - key_mode makes the publication conditional: "if_new" publishes only a key which does not exist yet, "if_exists" only one which does.
- `stream_data: JSON = None` - stream_data is not used by Centrifugo yet.
- `b64stream_data: str = ''` - b64stream_data is not used by Centrifugo yet.
- `idempotency_key: str = ''` - idempotency_key makes the publication idempotent: another one with the same key within the broker's idempotency window is not published.
- `delta: bool = False` - delta enables delta compression for the publication.
- `version: int = 0` - version is the key's version: Centrifugo drops a publication older than the key's latest.
- `version_epoch: str = ''` - version_epoch scopes version, for versions which may start over.

#### `MapRemoveRequest`

MapRemoveRequest is sent when a client removes a key from a map channel.

- `client: str = ''` - client is the unique ID Centrifugo gave the connection.
- `transport: str = ''` - transport is the connection's transport.
- `protocol: str = ''` - protocol is the client protocol: "json" or "protobuf".
- `encoding: str = ''` - encoding is "binary" when the proxy has binary_encoding enabled, so that payloads come in the b64 fields, and "json" otherwise.
- `user: str = ''` - user is the connection's user ID.
- `channel: str = ''` - channel is the map channel the client removes the key from.
- `key: str = ''` - key is the key the client removes.
- `meta: JSON = None` - meta is the connection's meta, when the proxy has include_connection_meta.
- `labels: dict[str, str] = {}` - PRO only — connection labels attached to the originating centrifuge.Client. Centrifugo PRO always populates this from Client.Labels() (no opt-in toggle).

#### `MapRemoveResult`

MapRemoveResult accepts the removal, even when empty. Fields left unset
keep what the client sent, or the defaults.

- `key: str = ''` - key replaces the key the client sent.
- `tags: dict[str, str] = {}` - tags are attached to the removal publication. When unset, the removed entry's own tags are.
- `idempotency_key: str = ''` - idempotency_key makes the removal idempotent within the broker's idempotency window.

#### `NotifyCacheEmptyRequest`

NotifyCacheEmptyRequest is sent when a client subscribed to a channel in
cache recovery mode which has no publication to recover from. Centrifugo
PRO only.

- `channel: str = ''` - channel is the channel whose cache is empty.

#### `NotifyCacheEmptyResult`

NotifyCacheEmptyResult is the NotifyCacheEmptyResult message of the Centrifugo proxy protocol.

- `populated: bool = False` - populated tells Centrifugo that the backend published into the channel, so that it tries to recover the state once more.

#### `NotifyChannelStateRequest`

NotifyChannelStateRequest carries channel state events. Centrifugo PRO
only, in preview.

- `events: list[ChannelEvent] = []` - events are the events which happened, in channels with presence.

#### `NotifyChannelStateResult`

NotifyChannelStateResult is the NotifyChannelStateResult message of the Centrifugo proxy protocol.

#### `PublishRequest`

PublishRequest is sent when a client publishes into a channel.

- `client: str = ''` - client is the unique ID Centrifugo gave the connection.
- `transport: str = ''` - transport is the connection's transport.
- `protocol: str = ''` - protocol is the client protocol: "json" or "protobuf".
- `encoding: str = ''` - encoding is "binary" when the proxy has binary_encoding enabled, so that payloads come in the b64 fields, and "json" otherwise.
- `user: str = ''` - user is the connection's user ID.
- `channel: str = ''` - channel is the channel the client publishes into.
- `data: JSON = None` - data is the data the client publishes.
- `b64data: str = ''` - b64data is data in base64, sent instead of data in binary encoding mode.
- `meta: JSON = None` - meta is the connection's meta, when the proxy has include_connection_meta.
- `labels: dict[str, str] = {}` - PRO only — connection labels attached to the originating centrifuge.Client. Centrifugo PRO always populates this from Client.Labels() (no opt-in toggle).

#### `PublishResult`

PublishResult accepts the publication. Fields left unset keep what the
client sent, or the defaults.

- `data: JSON = None` - data replaces the data the client sent.
- `b64data: str = ''` - b64data is data in base64, for binary data.
- `skip_history: bool = False` - skip_history publishes without saving the publication to the channel's history. Not allowed in channels with delta compression.
- `tags: dict[str, str] = {}` - tags are attached to the publication: clients cannot send tags, so this is where server-side tag filters get their tags from.
- `idempotency_key: str = ''` - idempotency_key makes the publication idempotent: another one with the same key in the channel within the broker's idempotency window is not published.
- `delta: bool = False` - delta enables delta compression for the publication.
- `version: int = 0` - version is the publication's version, for channels whose publications each carry the whole state: Centrifugo drops one older than the latest.
- `version_epoch: str = ''` - version_epoch scopes version, for versions which may start over - when they come from a system which can lose its state, say.

#### `RPCRequest`

RPCRequest is sent when a client makes an RPC call.

- `client: str = ''` - client is the unique ID Centrifugo gave the connection.
- `transport: str = ''` - transport is the connection's transport.
- `protocol: str = ''` - protocol is the client protocol: "json" or "protobuf".
- `encoding: str = ''` - encoding is "binary" when the proxy has binary_encoding enabled, so that payloads come in the b64 fields, and "json" otherwise.
- `user: str = ''` - user is the connection's user ID.
- `method: str = ''` - method is the method the client calls, empty if it named none.
- `data: JSON = None` - data is the data the client sent with the call.
- `b64data: str = ''` - b64data is data in base64, sent instead of data in binary encoding mode.
- `meta: JSON = None` - meta is the connection's meta, when the proxy has include_connection_meta.
- `labels: dict[str, str] = {}` - PRO only — connection labels attached to the originating centrifuge.Client. Centrifugo PRO always populates this from Client.Labels() (no opt-in toggle).

#### `RPCResult`

RPCResult is the call's result.

- `data: JSON = None` - data is the result sent to the client: any JSON.
- `b64data: str = ''` - b64data is data in base64, for binary data.

#### `RefreshRequest`

RefreshRequest is sent when a connection is about to expire.

- `client: str = ''` - client is the unique ID Centrifugo gave the connection.
- `transport: str = ''` - transport is the connection's transport.
- `protocol: str = ''` - protocol is the client protocol: "json" or "protobuf".
- `encoding: str = ''` - encoding is "binary" when the proxy has binary_encoding enabled, so that payloads come in the b64 fields, and "json" otherwise.
- `user: str = ''` - user is the connection's user ID.
- `meta: JSON = None` - meta is the connection's meta, when the proxy has include_connection_meta.
- `labels: dict[str, str] = {}` - PRO only — connection labels attached to the originating centrifuge.Client. Centrifugo PRO always populates this from Client.Labels() (no opt-in toggle).

#### `RefreshResult`

RefreshResult extends the connection, or ends it.

- `expired: bool = False` - expired disconnects the client: its connection has expired.
- `expire_at: int = 0` - expire_at is when the connection expires next, in Unix seconds.
- `info: JSON = None` - info replaces the connection's info, as JSON.
- `b64info: str = ''` - b64info is info in base64, for binary info.
- `meta: JSON = None` - meta replaces the connection's meta, as JSON.
- `caps: list[ChannelsCapability] = []` - caps replace the connection's capabilities. Centrifugo PRO only.

#### `SharedPollRefreshItem`

SharedPollRefreshItem is an item to refresh.

- `key: str = ''` - key is the item's key.
- `version: int = 0` - version is the latest version of the item Centrifugo has, in versioned mode: zero when it has none. Not set in versionless mode.

#### `SharedPollRefreshRequest`

SharedPollRefreshRequest asks for the current data of items tracked in a
shared poll channel.

- `channel: str = ''` - channel is the shared poll channel.
- `items: list[SharedPollRefreshItem] = []` - items are the tracked items to refresh.

#### `SharedPollRefreshResult`

SharedPollRefreshResult carries the items' current data. An item left out
is unchanged.

- `items: list[SharedPollRefreshResultItem] = []` - items are the items' current data.
- `epoch: str = ''` - epoch identifies the publisher's version space: when it differs from the channel's, Centrifugo drops the versions and data it keeps and resubscribes the channel's subscribers. Generate one per process start, and send the same one with direct publishes. Empty means versions are never reset.

#### `SharedPollRefreshResultItem`

SharedPollRefreshResultItem is an item's current data.

- `key: str = ''` - key is the item's key.
- `data: JSON = None` - data is the item's data. In versioned mode it may be left out for an item which has not changed.
- `version: int = 0` - version is the item's version: required in versioned mode, optional in versionless mode. It must grow when the item changes.
- `removed: bool = False` - removed removes the item: subscribers are told so, and it is no longer tracked.
- `prev_data: JSON = None` - prev_data is the item's previous data, the base for delta compression when the namespace uses it, so that Centrifugo need not keep it.

#### `SubRefreshRequest`

SubRefreshRequest is sent when a subscription is about to expire.

- `client: str = ''` - client is the unique ID Centrifugo gave the connection.
- `transport: str = ''` - transport is the connection's transport.
- `protocol: str = ''` - protocol is the client protocol: "json" or "protobuf".
- `encoding: str = ''` - encoding is "binary" when the proxy has binary_encoding enabled, so that payloads come in the b64 fields, and "json" otherwise.
- `user: str = ''` - user is the connection's user ID.
- `channel: str = ''` - channel is the channel whose subscription is about to expire.
- `meta: JSON = None` - meta is the connection's meta, when the proxy has include_connection_meta.
- `labels: dict[str, str] = {}` - PRO only — connection labels attached to the originating centrifuge.Client. Centrifugo PRO always populates this from Client.Labels() (no opt-in toggle).

#### `SubRefreshResult`

SubRefreshResult extends the subscription, or ends it.

- `expired: bool = False` - expired ends the subscription: it has expired.
- `expire_at: int = 0` - expire_at is when the subscription expires next, in Unix seconds.
- `info: JSON = None` - info replaces the channel-specific information about the connection, as JSON.
- `b64info: str = ''` - b64info is info in base64, for binary info.
- `server_tags_filter: FilterNode | None = None` - server_tags_filter, when set, replaces the server-side tags filter of the subscription (Centrifugo PRO). When not set the filter is kept as it is.

#### `SubscribeOptionOverride`

SubscribeOptionOverride overrides channel options of the namespace for one
subscription. An unset field keeps the namespace's value.

- `presence: bool | None = None` - presence overrides the namespace's presence option.
- `join_leave: bool | None = None` - join_leave overrides the namespace's join_leave option.
- `force_recovery: bool | None = None` - force_recovery overrides the namespace's force_recovery option.
- `force_positioning: bool | None = None` - force_positioning overrides the namespace's force_positioning option.
- `force_push_join_leave: bool | None = None` - force_push_join_leave overrides the namespace's force_push_join_leave option.

#### `SubscribeOptions`

SubscribeOptions are the options of a server-side subscription returned in
ConnectResult.subs.

- `expire_at: int = 0` - expire_at is when the subscription expires, in Unix seconds. Zero means it does not expire.
- `info: JSON = None` - info is channel-specific information about the connection, as JSON: it is part of presence data, join and leave events and the client's publications in the channel.
- `b64info: str = ''` - b64info is info in base64, for binary info.
- `data: JSON = None` - data is custom data sent to the client with the subscription in the connect reply.
- `b64data: str = ''` - b64data is data in base64, for binary data.
- `override: SubscribeOptionOverride | None = None` - override overrides channel options of the namespace for this subscription.
- `server_tags_filter: FilterNode | None = None` - server_tags_filter makes the subscription receive only publications whose tags match it. Centrifugo PRO only.
- `cache_recover: bool = False` - cache_recover, when set, makes Centrifugo initiate cache recovery for the server-side subscription without requiring the client to provide a recover flag/position itself. This is the server-side equivalent of subscribing with an empty `since` on the client. Mostly useful for unidirectional clients which do not know channel names. Requires recovery to be enabled for the channel and only applies in cache recovery mode, where it delivers the latest publication on (re)subscribe.

#### `SubscribeRequest`

SubscribeRequest is sent when a client subscribes to a channel.

- `client: str = ''` - client is the unique ID Centrifugo gave the connection.
- `transport: str = ''` - transport is the connection's transport.
- `protocol: str = ''` - protocol is the client protocol: "json" or "protobuf".
- `encoding: str = ''` - encoding is "binary" when the proxy has binary_encoding enabled, so that payloads come in the b64 fields, and "json" otherwise.
- `user: str = ''` - user is the connection's user ID.
- `channel: str = ''` - channel is the channel the client subscribes to.
- `token: str = ''` - token is the subscription token the client sent for the channel, if any.
- `meta: JSON = None` - meta is the connection's meta, when the proxy has include_connection_meta.
- `data: JSON = None` - data is the custom data the client sent with its subscribe command, if any.
- `b64data: str = ''` - b64data is data in base64, sent instead of data in binary encoding mode.
- `labels: dict[str, str] = {}` - PRO only — connection labels attached to the originating centrifuge.Client. Centrifugo PRO always populates this from Client.Labels() (no opt-in toggle).

#### `SubscribeResult`

SubscribeResult accepts the subscription.

- `expire_at: int = 0` - expire_at is when the subscription expires, in Unix seconds, unless refreshed - by the sub refresh proxy, when one is configured. Zero means it does not expire.
- `info: JSON = None` - info is channel-specific information about the connection, as JSON: it is part of presence data, join and leave events and the client's publications in the channel.
- `b64info: str = ''` - b64info is info in base64, for binary info.
- `data: JSON = None` - data is custom data sent to the client in the subscribe reply.
- `b64data: str = ''` - b64data is data in base64, for binary data.
- `override: SubscribeOptionOverride | None = None` - override overrides channel options of the namespace for this subscription.
- `allow: list[str] = []` - allow are capabilities granted in the channel for this subscription: "sub", "pub", "hst" and "prs". Centrifugo PRO only.
- `server_tags_filter: FilterNode | None = None` - server_tags_filter makes the subscription receive only publications whose tags match it. Centrifugo PRO only.

</details>
